scientific_choices.choice: User-authorized update to benchmark-style dont-care neutralization in this external YOLO experiment. The paper does not define ignore semantics. Approximate mode only; see DCE-001.

The inspected benchmark evaluator neutralizes a prediction if intersection with any single ignored GT polygon divided by prediction area is strictly greater than0.5. Use original annotation vertices and native Polygon3 geometry, without per-vertex clamping, bbox approximation or union of ignored regions.
Reuse unchanged frozen detector/crop/PARSeq/confidence/NMS decisions. All GT-dependent exclusion happens only in metrics. No images, crop pixels or recognizer input are changed.

Retain prior exact normalized care bbox matching on ICDAR13/ICDAR15/Total-Text and word-occurrence line support on CTW. This is not a complete official end-to-end score. Retain the same threshold grid as an exploratory TEST control.

Run pure geometry in the existing isolated Python3.8 environment, pin Polygon3/Shapely versions and extension hashes. Shapely make_valid is only an independently logged geometry audit for invalid polygons; native Polygon3 inputs are never repaired or replaced.
Official care matching, transcription normalization/word-spotting filters, official GT revisions and CTW word geometry remain outside this isolated ignore-policy update.
